title: Rosemary Roast {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (204°C). Cut deep slits all over the {p} and push in slivers of garlic and small clusters of the {spice}. Rub with oil, salt and pepper.
Set the {p} on a rack in a roasting pan.
Roast 15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 350°F (177°C) and roast about 1 hour more, until the thickest part is {doneness}. Check with a thermometer.
About 45 minutes before the lamb is done, start the sides. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Rest the {p} 15 to 20 minutes under foil.

Whisk 2 tablespoons of flour into the pan drippings over medium heat for a minute, pour in the {sauce}, scrape up the browned bits and simmer 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Carve across the grain and serve with the {s}, the {v} and the gravy.
tip: Carve thin, take a small portion, and let the vegetables fill half the plate.
